title:
Ideally `LukeTestUiSdlDiagramNode` mixes `LukeBrowserWebElement` and `LukeTestUiSdlDiagram` can make instances with
`nodeEl`, however that results in a "Call stack exceeded" error.
Another alternative is for `LukeTestUiSdlDiagramNode` to mix `LukeTestComponent` but for that to be helpful,
we need to set `parentSelector`. However, `LukeBrowserWebElement#webElementSelector` (and LukeBrowserWebElement#selector)
resolve to undefined.
Last resort is to just wrap the `nodeEl` and supply some common functions that are on `LukeBrowserWebElement`.
name: LukeTestUiSdlDiagramNode
